Class TaskManager

java.lang.Object
taskmanager.service.TaskManager
public class TaskManager extends Object
Manages tasks: add, view, update, delete and set status. All input validation lives here. If a CSV file is given, every change is saved to it.

      Updates an existing task.
      Parameters:
      id - id of the task to update
      title - new title (must not be blank)
      description - new description
      status - new status
      Returns:
